V35 removes that line entirely, replaces it with wide diffuse diagonal sky washes, a distinct irregular creamy cloud mass in the lower-left, warm peach brush glazing through the lower centre, small scattered brush marks and a low blue shoreline. The large prompt card and V34 hero typography proportions remain. V35 rendered candidate (Actions run 41313687657, commit 9086646) was inspected using the full 2fps contact sheet and extracted keyframes at 0.5/2/4/6/8/10/12/14/16/20/26/32/36 seconds. The composition is technically valid and the new diagonal washes are visible, but the lower-left cloud reads too much like a diffuse horizontal bank at delivery size. V36 strengthens asymmetrical overlapping cloud volumes, separates cool highlights from warm underpainting, adds broken mid-sky wisps and visible pigment/grain texture, and keeps the title-safe upper sky open. This is an original art-direction refinement; it does not claim pixel identity with unavailable source layers. V36 rendered and passed CI (Actions run 41315006194, commit 0ef212d), but a direct native-frame comparison against preview.mp4 frame 0 exposed an artistic mismatch: V36's lower-left cloud became a broad high cumulus mass and its sky read as soft horizontal colour bands. The original has a much airier blue field, long broken diagonal white/blue wisps from upper-left toward upper-right, a peach-pink diagonal glaze, small low cream/coral cloud islands near the horizon, and a dark blue irregular hill/waterline. V37 explicitly changes the silhouette and stroke direction to match those visible source characteristics while retaining the source-matched title and prompt-card layout. V37 rendered successfully in Actions run 41315724268 and was reviewed at native frames 0 and 30. Compared to preview.mp4, V37's cloud bank still reads as repeated scallop-like bubbles, its blue hill becomes a nearly continuous flat water band, its title hierarchy is undersized, its typed prompt is too far advanced at frame30, and its cursor is too central rather than starting at bottom-right and moving to Submit by frame60. V38 therefore changes the cloud artwork to isolated low painterly patches, the hills to two irregular layered ridgelines, enlarges the headline, corrects typewriter cadence to placeholder at frame0 / 'Introducing' around frame30 / full prompt at frame60, and keys cursor motion from bottom-right to the send control. V38 passed the full technical render and was reviewed against preview.mp4 at native frames 0/30/60. Headline scale and the typing/cursor landmarks now closely match the reference. Remaining visible differences are the synthetic smooth quality of the cloud strokes, too little pigment variation, and the prompt's working-directory label sitting inside the white field instead of a separate translucent lower shelf. V39 adds irregular dry-brush displacement, stronger watercolor grain and pigment flecks, richer low cream/peach cloud patches and a more source-like rolling hill silhouette; the UI now separates the opaque composing field from its translucent directory shelf without changing source-keyed typing or cursor timing. V39 passed all technical gates in Actions run 41318079131 and was inspected at native frame 0. The new pigment edge/grain pass improved paint texture, but the upper sky's high-contrast diagonal marks became too many near-parallel bands, unlike the source's softer broad brush wash. V40 deliberately reduces the mark count and uses three irregular overlapping washes (white/cool, mid-sky blue, and warm peach at upper-right), plus fewer scattered pigment flecks. The source-timed 0/30/60 text and cursor, title scale and separate translucent directory shelf are retained.
reference.constraints: Match native source cut frames, typography, poster composition, Launch Film pane geometry and preview order, provider medallions, MORRO transition and camera-like app tile. Artwork is independently-authored SVG/CSS; no pixel-identity claim without original editable source layers/fonts. V19 specifically reproduces the source timing at frames 496-516 and the eight discrete Star History labels at 523-530; the cube uses a reduced turn angle to expose multiple faces. The camera tile must transition from layered MORRO geometry into an illustrated rounded camera cube with a front portrait face, black glyph/arrow side, blue clock/artwork face, lime EASE face and cream editorial face; end lockup must preserve a legible domain capsule. Countdown 1 must be the same blue extruded prism in Preview and the enlarged Preview takeover; avoid changing it to a flat white numeral. Keep the near-full-frame black panel rounded and preserve the source's orange/blue orbital rings and blue corner wedge. The Launch Film preview zoom is not a generic scale: preserve the 780 source window geometry and reproduce frame-specific Preview card bounds at frames 885/889/890/891. Comic 1962 split panels must use a narrow 20% side rail on each side, with central pop-art radial scene, yellow/red target and yellow CLICK burst. The 1965 Infinity dots poster uses a dense irregular white dot field and yellow D-shaped app badge with black speckles. MORRO transitions from oversized repeating solid/outline type into a rounded typographic tile, blue/cream letterfield and violet folded ribbon, then glossy app icon. V30 source-specific corrections: the opening uses painterly watercolor clouds with a low horizon; the 1965 infinity mark is circular; the 1973 optics shot must show a rainbow spectrum splitting from the orb; the 1985 pixel-game shot contains a gold oval portal and white cursor; the MIND poster has a translucent faceted polyhedron; the eye poster is an angular blue-grid iris on black with 3.7% bottom-right; the camera cube shows the clock only on the top at frame990, a black glyph on the camera-facing side, yellow 100K at frame1005, and the black app face at frame1020. Final brand lockup should be materially larger. V31 MORRO frame905 is a full-contrast centred cream tile approximately 1,120px square, not a translucent small card over the repeating typography. By frame915 it contracts to approximately 720px and transitions into a blue/cream letter tile crossed by broad purple folded bands. At cube frame990 the blue/gold clock must be visibly presented on the top plane while the black glyph remains camera-facing; do not substitute the clock for the front face. The 100K face uses dense green halftone and large bold 100K lettering. For camera cube: the clock belongs on the top plane at source frame990 and must be transferred to the adjacent side at source frame1005. The green EASE lower fold remains below the camera-facing black mark; never put the full EASE face on top. The opening sky must read as painterly clouds with irregular organic clusters, varied soft/wet edges, pastel blue/cream/pink haze and low distant blue horizon, not a repeated scalloped band or clean horizontal gradient rows. The MOTION word has tight but non-colliding letter spacing. Opening cloud background must resemble a soft watercolor painting: wide diagonal cloud wisps, diffuse overlapping cloud banks weighted to lower-left, irregular hand-painted edges, a blue/cream/pink atmospheric wash and a low dark blue hill/waterline. Do not use repeated white scallop rows or several clean horizontal bands. The prompt card should use 290px side margins, top390, height330. At global frame100, MOTION title should be much larger (370px class), OpenDesign 132px class, Introducing 40px class, with no fabricated bottom strapline. Opening cloudscape must not contain a continuous wavy/scalloped line along the top. Use broad diagonal and broken translucent washes; a clearly visible irregular cream-white cloud mass sits in the lower-left, with peach/pink paint strokes across lower centre and blue/teal hills at the bottom. Keep the sky predominantly open blue rather than filling it with cloud outlines.
